legal.privacyDescription: How DraftMaster AI collects, uses and protects your data.
legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains what data DraftMaster AI collects when you use draftmaster.wiki, why we collect it, and the choices you have. We keep it deliberately short because we collect very little.
legal.privacyData: We store an anonymous identifier in your browser so your daily free analyses and any premium entitlement follow you without an account. If you run an analysis we store the enemy hero ids, the role and rank you selected, and the result metadata to improve the product. If you give us an email address we store it with your consent. We do not collect names, addresses or payment card details.
legal.privacyUse: To run the analyses you ask for, to enforce the free daily limit, to verify premium entitlements, to measure which features are used, and to email you only if you explicitly asked. We do not sell your data and we run no third-party advertising trackers.
legal.privacyPayments: Purchases are handled by Lemon Squeezy, our merchant of record. Your payment card details are provided directly to them and never reach our servers. Lemon Squeezy acts as the seller of record and handles applicable taxes. Their handling of your data is governed by their own privacy policy.
legal.privacyThird: Hero, item and match statistics come from the public OpenDota and Valve APIs. Dota 2 is a trademark of Valve Corporation; DraftMaster AI is not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve.
legal.privacyRetention: Usage events are kept in aggregate to understand product health. Entitlement records are kept while your subscription is active and for a reasonable period afterwards for accounting. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.
legal.privacyRights: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data, and you can withdraw consent for email at any time. Contact us at
legal.termsDescription: The terms that govern your use of DraftMaster AI.
legal.termsIntro: By using DraftMaster AI at draftmaster.wiki you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
legal.termsService: DraftMaster AI generates draft-time advice for Dota 2 — hero suggestions, item builds, skill builds, win conditions and related analysis — computed from public match statistics. The service is provided as-is and may change.
legal.termsNotAffiliated: Dota 2 and all related assets are trademarks of Valve Corporation. DraftMaster AI is an independent product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Valve Corporation.
legal.termsPlans: A free plan includes a limited number of analyses per day. Premium is a paid subscription billed through Lemon Squeezy, our merchant of record, who handles taxes and payment processing. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. You can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the paid period.
legal.termsAcceptable: Do not attempt to bypass the free-usage limits, disrupt the service, scrape it at volume, or use it to break any applicable law. We may suspend access for abuse.
legal.termsDisclaimer: Our recommendations are statistical estimates, not promises. Dota 2 outcomes depend on many factors outside the draft. We do not guarantee any particular win rate, rank increase or result.
legal.termsLiability: To the maximum extent permitted by law, DraftMaster AI is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the service. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under mandatory consumer law.
legal.refundDescription: How refunds work for DraftMaster AI Premium.
legal.refundIntro: We want you to be satisfied with DraftMaster AI Premium. This policy explains when and how you can get a refund.
legal.refundWindow: If Premium is not what you expected, contact us within 14 days of your purchase and we will refund your most recent payment. This applies to both monthly and annual plans.
legal.refundHow: Email us with the address you used at checkout, or the license key from your purchase email, and a one-line reason. We process refunds through Lemon Squeezy, so the money returns to your original payment method, usually within 5-10 business days. Email
legal.refundMor: Lemon Squeezy is the merchant of record for all purchases. Your payment appears on your statement as a Lemon Squeezy charge, and statutory refund rights in your jurisdiction always apply on top of this policy.
legal.refundCancel: You can cancel at any time using the link in your purchase email, or by asking us. Your access continues until the end of the period you already paid for; cancelling is not the same as a refund for time already used.
